stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]一家依据外国法律成立且位于美国境外的银行与一家美国银行保持着代理行关系,为其客户处理美元金融交易.根据2001年《美国爱国者法案》,所有美国银行和证券经纪自营商必须从与其开展业务的所有非美国外国银行客户那里获取一份签字确认书.2001年《美国爱国者法案》要求外国银行向美国银行证明哪些信息？(选择三项.)

options.A: 外国银行不允许政治公众人物(PEP)间接使用代理银行账户.
options.B: 外国银行设有实体机构的司法管辖区
options.C: 外国银行的业务将仅限于其注册所在国.
options.D: 外国银行的所有权详情
options.E: 外国银行不允许空壳银行间接使用代理银行账户。

stem_en: A bank organized under foreign law and located outside of the U.S. maintains a correspondent banking relationship with a U.S.-based bank to handle financial transactions in U.S. dollars for its clients. In compliance with the USA PATRIOT Act of 2001, all U.S. banks and broker-dealers in securities must obtain a signed certification from all non-U.S. foreign bank clients conducting business with them. What information does the USA PATRIOT Act of 2001 require the foreign bank to certify to the U.S. bank? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: The foreign bank will not allow Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) to indirectly use the correspondent bank accounts.
options_en.B: The jurisdictions in which the foreign bank maintains a physical presence.
options_en.C: The foreign bank's business will be limited to its country of incorporation.
options_en.D: Details of the foreign bank's ownership.
options_en.E: The foreign bank will not allow indirect use of the correspondent bank accounts by shell banks.
